# GitHub Copilot / IDE agents — Fluent Mobile

Use the same contracts as other tools:

1. [`CLAUDE.md`](../CLAUDE.md) — cross-tool entrypoint
2. [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) — delivery gates
3. [`docs/AGENT_ONBOARDING.md`](../docs/AGENT_ONBOARDING.md)
4. [`docs/guides/project-board.md`](../docs/guides/project-board.md) — plus [`.cursor/rules/foreign-tickets.mdc`](../.cursor/rules/foreign-tickets.mdc) (do not mutate non–fluent-mobile tickets without per-ID confirmation)
5. [`docs/guides/expo-first-dependencies.md`](../docs/guides/expo-first-dependencies.md)
6. [`.cursor/rules/`](../.cursor/rules/) — readable Markdown rules (not Cursor-only)

Do not invent a separate Copilot workflow that conflicts with those docs.
